page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes stand in the right margin, in short phrases beside the lines where they occur, some hyphenated. Below the text: a gathering signature at the bottom left and a catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: aliùs euaporat: in ventriculo frigidiore accessit, praecordiaq; flatibus distenditur: in calidiori corpo-ris temperamento aduritur, inq; nidorosos halitus effumat, capitiq; affert grauedinem. Ergo, cum eius natura sit lac, vt calore densescat ac spisse-tur, frigore vero liquescat, fit vt in estuanti sto-Lac in ve-triculomacho promtius coaguletur, coagulatum & in grumos conuersum periculosa sepe accidentia excitet, praesertim in faeminis, coagulatio illa coagula-tionemnulla re efficacius inhiberi potest, quàm melle vel tum pef-[?]saccharo salisq; momento: Confirmat id Galenus lib. 5. de morbis curandis, his verbis, porro hoc & quid tibi de lactis vsu pro maximo praecepto sit, vt ii quibus eo opus est, omnino id astante animali statim multum bibant etiam melle iniecto, si cui prohi-beat.in ventriculo solet, & si ipsum descendere ad alvum citius cupis, etiam sale.

Quapropter detestandus nobilium quarundam faeminarum adolescentularumq; mos est, quae inter coenae & prandii tempus, vel etiam statim a prandio colostris ac lactis cremore, aliisq; lactariis se infarciunt, vinoq; postea affatim ea perfundere nonCensura. verentur maximo valetudinis detrimento. Notum est, plurimos ex lacte sic coagulato, eoq; in grumos cocreto strangulari, spirandiq; difficultate, oborto vomitu, opprimi. Vinum enim coagulare facit lac, atque in cafei consistentiam conglobari, quo cum offendatur stomachus, ac inter se repugnantia elaborare nequeat, omnia ad Vinumlac facitputredinem vergere necesse est, grauiumq; mor-
Note: the printed margin notes "coalesce-re." appear beside the last full lines and are part of the same right-margin column.

page.notes: The right-margin notes are short hyphenated fragments that continue the phrases in the running text. Uncertain: "tum pef-" in the line beginning "melle vel" is not clear to me; the word after "pef-" is probably "saccharo". The signature "Nn 5" has its numeral uncertain. The "Censura." and "coalesce-re." notes are read as margin notes. The text ends with a hyphen at "mor-", continuing to the next page. The page number and running head are as printed; the head has been transcribed as "PROROGANDA." because the letters are unclear.
